prefix.Применяется к любой открытой позиции: Applies to any open position without its own token rule. For copy trading this is the only workable option: the token is new every time, so you can't set a rule for it in advance. Zero or empty = threshold off. The stop-loss sign doesn't matter: “6” and “-6” mean the same.
An upper estimate, not a promise. The order of events inside a trade isn't stored: if both stop and take would trigger, the worse case counts — stop first. Real exit may differ.
prefix.Результат сделок в зависимости от параме: Trade results by order parameters. Bar length — number of trades, right — share of winners and average result. Helps tune filters by facts, not guesses.
How much the trader buys per cycle. 0 = no limit
Upper limit of the amount per cycle. Useful if large cycles don't interest you. 0 = no limit
prefix.Какая часть расписания кита уже выполнен: How much of the whale's schedule is already done at entry. Entering at the end means buying when buy support is almost over.
prefix.Уведомление о входе приходит только при: A sign-in notice arrives only for a NEW device: reopening the app or refreshing the page doesn't count. “It's me” turns off notices for this address.
